repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a one-time pre-cycle sequence (wait, close valve, send mail) followed by an infinite cycle of sending mail every 1 minute. The candidate incorrectly repeats the entire pre-cycle sequence (wait + close valve + send mail) in the `else` branch of the periodic wrapper. This causes the valve to close and mail to be sent again at t=60s, which contradicts the IR where only the mail action repeats.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the `else` branch entirely. The IR's `cycle` with no `until` condition implies infinite repetition of the body. The pre-cycle actions (wait and valve close) must only execute once at the start. The revised script executes the wait and valve close once, then enters the periodic loop that only performs the mail action.
